proposed_capability: Preserve authorized last-resort agent computer control while pausing behavior during operator activity, differentiate passive listener result identity from gameplay effects, and capture every calibrated discovery as a bounded deterministic source-and-test obligation.
player_save_control_impact: No new screen input, save access, raw key/mouse capture, OS hooks, daemon or background activation. An explicitly active listener and approved passive adapter can observe without focusing or modifying Sims. Each screen action still requires existing human-first idle, exclusive lock, scene/save/queue/target admission.
expected_outcome: A trusted read-only listener can finish while the operator is active without being misidentified as a completed agent gameplay effect. The same pending screen action survives player interruption and resumes only upon fresh idle/admission. Every attempted effect and reviewed semantic discovery can be paged into a source-code and regression-test backlog; submission claims remain unverified until provider readback.
negative_tests: Listener returns COMPLETED with a distinct work_id while gameplay action is paused: no gameplay effect or outcome is accepted
Failing passive listener returns reconciliation under its own ID, never the pending action
User input blocks gameplay effects until fresh two-probe 15-second idle, even after safe semantic observation
Unknown/cross-scope/raw discovery fields and duplicate evidence are rejected
Every attempted action appears in bounded codification pages including interrupted and harmful outcomes
Submitted codification receipt is not considered independently merged or game certified
rollback_path: Revert only optional listener result tagging, discovery capture and codification projections; retain the verified native-first, player-first and host queue owners, BI-002 work and last-known-good profile.
unresolved_unknowns: This provider session cannot inspect actual installed Sims runtime or physical user idle sensor
Local MoonWake walker stage execution and runtime native P08 must be certified on the host
Committed source and test evidence is independent of eventual game-native behavior and player consent
decision_rationale: MoonWake Sixth Gear P141 rejects duplicate UI daemon, false listener completion and source-claim-as-merge; P95/P82 introduce typed passive source identification and replay/negative tests; P08 remains local-game-only; P07/P124 integrate under existing runtime, provenance and player-first owners. Retain code/tests for every learned action instead of recomputing across contexts.
